name: Niutou Zhen de Kuaile Gushi
source:
10-year-old Wang Nan plans to go to the provincial capital during the summer vacation, but many incredible things suddenly happen in the town, and many of them are related to him... So where should he go?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783510/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
10岁的王楠计划暑假去省城，但小镇里突然发生了许多不可思议的事情，而且很多都与他有关……那么他该去哪里呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783510/]Steam[/url]]
